purpose: Industrial black-and-white logo concepts for The Unbound Launcher

options.name: 01 / DOT PORTAL
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a polished industrial black-and-white logo exploration for THE UNBOUND LAUNCHER, a spatial Android launcher for AR glasses.
Asset type: one logo concept on a clean landscape presentation board. Show a dominant primary horizontal logo on white in the upper two thirds, and a smaller white-on-black version on a black strip across the lower third, including a standalone app-icon symbol on that strip. Consistent optical balance, generous whitespace, sharp flat vector-like edges. Black and white only.
Text (verbatim): "THE" small, "UNBOUND" dominant, "LAUNCHER" small. Spell UNBOUND exactly U N B O U N D. All letters must be legible.
Only include the brand text and the concept number/name specified below, small at upper left. No other captions, mockups, slogans, texture, gradients, gray shading, lighting, perspective, glow, chrome, photographic elements, blue or other colors. The art should feel like a precise piece of hardware identity.
Concept label: "01 / DOT PORTAL".
Direction: A powerful open U/portal constructed entirely of perfectly uniform circular dots on a strict square matrix. Two-dot-thick U stroke, roughly 11 dots wide by 11 dots high, broad empty inner counter. Raise the right arm above the left, with one or two detached dots continuing upward to suggest breaking a boundary. The U must still read immediately and have a distinctive squared-bottom industrial silhouette with clipped corners. Pair the matrix U with a heavy, compact, geometric grotesk UNBOUND wordmark in solid type, custom technical squared details, small widely spaced THE and LAUNCHER. Every dot is precise, evenly spaced and pure black. Favor a sparse bold matrix over a dense halftone.

Concept label: "02 / HARD STENCIL".
Direction: A heavy, angular U milled from a solid block, open at the top, squared outer corners and chamfered lower corners. A precise diagonal separation on the upper right arm suggests the U breaks free from its frame. No arrows or chevrons. UNBOUND is a custom wide military-equipment stencil wordmark, carefully placed narrow bridges, powerful straight cuts, still clear and elegant. THE and LAUNCHER are small neutral technical monospaced text. A tiny disciplined 2 by 4 dot array may serve as an integrated detail, but the central identity is a machined stencil, clearly different from a dot-matrix symbol. Flat solid black shapes with white negative space.

Concept label: "03 / MATRIX TYPE".
Direction: Make the dominant UNBOUND wordmark itself a precisely aligned 5 by 7 circular dot-matrix alphabet, highly legible, like a premium industrial instrument display. Seven letterforms, UNBOUND, equal-height dots and consistent spacing; enough weight and dots that letters are immediately recognizable. THE above and LAUNCHER below are smaller, restrained, widely tracked monospaced solid uppercase. A compact matching U icon at left uses the same circular dot matrix and a small break at the upper right. This concept should be typography-first and wide, minimal, uncompromisingly black and white. Do not create gradients from dot sizes: every dot is the same diameter.
options.refinement_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit target: the supplied 03 / MATRIX TYPE logo concept board. Preserve its layout, black-and-white palette, brand text "THE UNBOUND LAUNCHER", label "03 / MATRIX TYPE", primary lockup on white, and inverse lockup on black. Change only the quality and regularity of the dot-matrix letterforms and icon. Every dot must be a perfect solid circle of exactly equal size, snapped to a strict regular square grid, with crisp edges and clean consistent gaps. Remove ALL slivers, half dots, smears, overlaps, irregular dots and broken circular fragments, especially within the letter B and near the N. The full wordmark must clearly read UNBOUND using an authentic uniform circular matrix with the same large scale and visual weight as the reference. Clean geometric circular dots, no texture, no blur, no distress. Keep the compact U icon readable, and ensure the lower inverse lockup uses the exact same geometry as the primary. Retain the generous whitespace and flat graphic presentation.

Concept label: "04 / SCANLINE".
Direction: A strong open U/portal symbol made of 7-9 parallel horizontal black scanlines, with precisely aligned white channels. The lines form a thick geometric U with two vertical arms and an open counter; squared forms and chamfered lower corners.
